frontmatter.title: Changelog
frontmatter.description: Release history for ZigBase, following Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning.

frontmatter.title: Known limitations
frontmatter.description: Current caveats in ZigBase — auth/email, framework hooks, schema migrations, fields, the scheduler, platform/UI gaps, and deferred work.

frontmatter.title: Relationship abilities
frontmatter.description: Per-collection, per-action authorization by the principal's relationship to the row — declaring abilities, ctx.can, and the abilities endpoint.

frontmatter.title: Product analytics
frontmatter.description: Capturing immutable events with ctx.track, declarative rollups, and the tenant-scoped analytics read API.

frontmatter.title: API
frontmatter.description: The ZigBase HTTP REST and realtime WebSocket reference — collections, records, query grammar, access rules, auth, OAuth2, files, and realtime.

frontmatter.title: Dart SDK
frontmatter.description: The official zigbase_client Dart SDK — auth, records, offset + cursor pagination, files, and realtime, for the Dart VM, Flutter, and Flutter web.

frontmatter.title: Docker
frontmatter.description: The official ghcr.io/valthon/zigbase image — quick start, data-volume ownership, non-root user, network bind, healthchecks, and tags.

frontmatter.title: Email
frontmatter.description: Sending application mail — templates, SES/Postmark/SMTP providers, verified senders, bounce suppression, and asserting mail in tests.

frontmatter.title: Fields
frontmatter.description: The complete catalog of ZigBase field types and their options — text, email, url, editor, date, autodate, bool, number, json, select, relation, and file.

frontmatter.title: Framework
frontmatter.description: Embed ZigBase as a Zig library — comptime record hooks, custom routes, scheduled jobs, a comptime schema with additive auto-migration, pluggable storage/mailer backends, and footprint levers.

frontmatter.title: Jobs & webhooks
frontmatter.description: Background queues, workers, and job kinds — plus signed outbound webhooks with retry, backoff, and idempotency keys.

frontmatter.title: PostgreSQL backend
frontmatter.description: Run ZigBase on PostgreSQL — the -Dpostgres build, ZIGBASE_DB_URL, multi-instance realtime, migrating from SQLite with migrate-db, and pgvector.

frontmatter.title: Realtime broadcast
frontmatter.description: Pushing to custom WebSocket channels from routes and jobs — signal vs broadcast, and gating subscriptions with canSubscribe.

frontmatter.title: Recipes
frontmatter.description: Copy-pasteable recipes — provisioning a schema, signup, owner-scoped access rules, validation hooks, custom routes, and DB access in cron jobs.

frontmatter.title: Full-text & vector search
frontmatter.description: Ranked ?search= queries on searchable fields, operators, how search composes with filters and rules, and opt-in -Dvector KNN.

frontmatter.title: Multi-tenancy
frontmatter.description: Account-scoped collections — enabling tenancy, tenant_field, accounts/memberships/invitations, roles, and the @request.account rule macros.

frontmatter.title: TypeScript SDK
frontmatter.description: The official @zigbase/client TypeScript SDK — auth, records, offset + cursor pagination, files, realtime, and the live store.
